
=== WebPanel: Calidad.reclamosww ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&Mode = TrnMode.Insert
	&RDId = 0
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_ReclamoFechaNotaCreditoAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFReclamoFechaCierre_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_ReclamoFechaCierreAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFReclamoFecha_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_ReclamoFechaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	Cell_Grid_DWC.Class = !'Invisible WCD_' + upper(Grid.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Reclamo'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Calidad.reclamoswwColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Calidad.reclamoswwColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ReclamoFecha.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ReclamoCodigo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ReclamoCliente.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	PlantaClienteNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ReclamoDescripcion.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	ReclamoCarretesReportados.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	ReclamoMillaresReportados.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	ReclamoFechaCierre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	ReclamoNotaCredito.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	ReclamoFechaNotaCredito.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoFecha'
					&TFReclamoFecha.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFReclamoFecha_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoCodigo'
					&TFReclamoCodigo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFReclamoCodigo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoCliente'
					&TFReclamoCliente = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFReclamoCliente_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PlantaClienteNombre'
					&TFPlantaClienteNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoDescripcion'
					&TFReclamoDescripcion = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoCarretesReportados'
					&TFReclamoCarretesReportados.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoMillaresReportados'
					&TFReclamoMillaresReportados.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoFechaCierre'
					&TFReclamoFechaCierre.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.Set(&TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.Year(), &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.Month(), &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoNotaCredito'
					&TFReclamoNotaCredito.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFReclamoNotaCredito_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ReclamoFechaNotaCredito'
					&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.Set(&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.Year(), &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.Month(), &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = Calidad.Reclamo.Link(TrnMode.Update, ReclamoId)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = Calidad.Reclamo.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ReclamoId)
	Endif
	&ActGroup.Clear()
	&ActGroup.AddItem(0, !";fa fa-cogs")
	If (&IsAuthorized_AddDetalle)
		&ActGroup.AddItem(1, format(!'%1;%2', "Agregar Carrete", !"fas fa-cog"))
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_Imprimir)
		&ActGroup.AddItem(2, format(!'%1;%2', "Formato Reporte", !"fas fa-print"))
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_FormatoTabular)
		&ActGroup.AddItem(3, format(!'%1;%2', "Formato Tabular", !"fas fa-table"))
	Endif
	If &ActGroup.Count = 1
		&ActGroup.Class = !'Invisible'
	Else
		&ActGroup.Class = !'ConvertToDDO'
	EndIf
	
	&DetailWebComponent = !'<i class="fas fa-info-circle"></i>'
	
	Do Case
		Case ReclamoEstatus = EstadoReclamo.Abierto
			&GridBadge = "Abierto"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Abierto"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagWarning BootstrapTooltipLeft'
		Case ReclamoEstatus = EstadoReclamo.Cerrado
			&GridBadge = "Cerrado"
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = "Cerrado"
			&GridBadge.Class = !' AttributeTagSuccess BootstrapTooltipLeft'
		Otherwise
			&GridBadge = ''
			&GridBadge.TooltipText = ''
			&GridBadge.Class = !''
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Calidad.reclamoswwColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Calidad.reclamoswwFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Calidad.reclamoswwFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = WWPBaseObjects.GetFilterByName(!'Calidad.reclamoswwFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				WWPBaseObjects.SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &ActGroup.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case &ActGroup = 1
			Do 'Do AddDetalle'
		Case &ActGroup = 2
			Do 'Do Imprimir'
		Case &ActGroup = 3
			Do 'Do FormatoTabular'
	EndCase
	&ActGroup = 0
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		Calidad.Reclamo.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ReclamoId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== WebPanel: Calidad.EditarReclamoDetalle ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'reclamodetalle_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'reclamodetalle_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'reclamodetalle_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&ReclamoDetalle.Load(&ReclamoDetalleId)
			&LoadSuccess = &ReclamoDetalle.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &ReclamoDetalle.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				ReclamoDetalle_ReclamoDetalleObservacionRCA.Enabled = False
				ReclamoDetalle_ReclamoDetalleCodigo.Enabled = False
				ReclamoDetalle_ReclamoDetalleEstado.Enabled = False
				ReclamoDetalle_ReclamoDetalleProductoId.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	ReclamoDetalle_ReclamoDetalleId.Visible = False
	ReclamoDetalle_ReclamoId.Visible = False
	GridLevel_CarreteDefecto_Empowerer.GridInternalName = GridLevel_CarreteDefecto.InternalName
	GridLevel_CarreteDefecto.Rows = 0
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert
		&ReclamoDetalle.Load(&ReclamoDetalleId)
	        &ReclamoDetalle.ReclamoId = &ReclamoId
	endif

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_CarreteDefecto.ColumnHeaderClass = !'WWIconActionColumn'
	ReclamoDetalle_CarreteDefecto__CarreteDefectoId.ColumnHeaderClass = !'WWColumn'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridLevel_CarreteDefecto.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the grid
	&LineDeleted = (&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.IndexOf(&ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto.IndexOf(&ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto.CurrentItem)) > 0)
	ReclamoDetalle_CarreteDefecto__CarreteDefectoId.Enabled = (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Update) AND (not &LineDeleted) AND &ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto.CurrentItem.ToXml().Contains(!'<Mode>INS</Mode>')
	&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_CarreteDefecto = !'<i class="fa fa-times TrnGridDelete"></i>'
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Update)
		&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_CarreteDefecto.Class = !'Attribute'
	Else
		&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_CarreteDefecto.Class = !'Invisible'
	Endif
	&DeleteGridLineGridLevel_CarreteDefecto.ColumnClass = iif(&LineDeleted, !'WWIconActionColumn WWColumnLineThrough WWColumnLineThroughFirstColumn', !'WWIconActionColumn')
	ReclamoDetalle_CarreteDefecto__CarreteDefectoId.ColumnClass = iif(&LineDeleted, !'WWColumn WWColumnLineThrough', !'WWColumn')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoAddGridLineGridLevel_CarreteDefecto' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoItem = new()
	&ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto.Add(&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoItem)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&ReclamoDetalle.Delete()
			Else
				&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Sort()
				Do While &ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Count > 0
					&ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto.Remove(&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Item(&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Count))
					&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Remove(&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Count)
				EndDo
				&ReclamoDetalle.Save()
			EndIf
			If &ReclamoDetalle.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &ReclamoDetalle.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &DeleteGridLineGridLevel_CarreteDefecto.Click (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Index = &ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto.IndexOf(&ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto.CurrentItem)
	If &ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.IndexOf(&Index) > 0
		&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Remove(&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.IndexOf(&Index))
	Else
		&ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefectoDeleted.Add(&Index)
	EndIf
	GridLevel_CarreteDefecto.Refresh()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&ReclamoDetalleId, &ReclamoId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: Calidad.Reclamo ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated PlantaClienteId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"PlantaClienteId"
					&Insert_PlantaClienteId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
    [web]
    {
	ReclamoId.Visible = False
	}
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ReclamoId);

ReclamoId = &ReclamoId if not &ReclamoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ReclamoId);
noprompt(DB.ReclamoId);

PlantaClienteId = &Insert_PlantaClienteId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_PlantaClienteId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(PlantaClienteId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_PlantaClienteId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditReclamo.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ReclamoId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditReclamo.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ReclamoId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditReclamo.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ReclamoId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditReclamo.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ReclamoId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

Default(ReclamoFecha, Today());
Default(ReclamoCodigo, 'HCMX_');

=== Procedure: Calidad.reclamoswwExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"reclamoswwExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoFecha.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoFecha_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Fecha")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFReclamoFecha
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFReclamoFecha_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoCodigo_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Código")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFReclamoCodigo_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFReclamoCodigo.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Código")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFReclamoCodigo)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoCliente_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cliente")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFReclamoCliente_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFReclamoCliente.IsEmpty())
			WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cliente")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFReclamoCliente)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Planta")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFPlantaClienteNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Planta")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFPlantaClienteNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripción")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFReclamoDescripcion.IsEmpty())
			WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripción")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFReclamoDescripcion)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoCarretesReportados.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To.IsEmpty())
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Carretes Reportados")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFReclamoCarretesReportados
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoMillaresReportados.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Millares Reportados")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFReclamoMillaresReportados
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoFechaCierre.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Fecha Cierre")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFReclamoFechaCierre
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoNotaCredito.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Nota de Crédito")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFReclamoNotaCredito
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Fecha Nota Crédito")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Calidad.reclamoswwColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Calidad.reclamoswwColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Reclamo
		order ReclamoFecha  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoFecha)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoCodigo  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoCodigo)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoCliente  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoCliente)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order PlantaClienteNombre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PlantaClienteNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoDescripcion  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoDescripcion)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoCarretesReportados  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoCarretesReportados)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoMillaresReportados  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoMillaresReportados)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoFechaCierre  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SAE.ReclamoFechaCierre)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoNotaCredito  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoNotaCredito)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoFechaNotaCredito  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoFechaNotaCredito)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using reclamoswwDS(&FilterFullText, &TFReclamoFecha, &TFReclamoFecha_To, &TFReclamoCodigo, &TFReclamoCodigo_Sel, &TFReclamoCliente
					, &TFReclamoCliente_Sel, &TFPlantaClienteNombre, &TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel, &TFReclamoDescripcion, &TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados
					, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To, &TFReclamoFechaCierre, &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To, &TFReclamoNotaCredito
					, &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoFecha'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = ReclamoFecha
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoCodigo'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ReclamoCodigo)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoCliente'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ReclamoCliente)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'PlantaClienteNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(PlantaClienteNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoDescripcion'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(ReclamoDescripcion)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoCarretesReportados'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ReclamoCarretesReportados
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoMillaresReportados'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ReclamoMillaresReportados
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoFechaCierre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = ReclamoFechaCierre
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoNotaCredito'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ReclamoNotaCredito
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ReclamoFechaNotaCredito'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = ReclamoFechaNotaCredito
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoFecha", '', !'Fecha', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoCodigo", '', !'Código', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoCliente", '', !'Cliente', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"PlantaClienteNombre", '', !'Planta', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoDescripcion", '', !'Descripción', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoCarretesReportados", '', !'Carretes Reportados', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoMillaresReportados", '', !'Millares Reportados', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoFechaCierre", '', !'Fecha Cierre', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoNotaCredito", '', !'Nota de Crédito', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ReclamoFechaNotaCredito", '', !'Fecha Nota Crédito', False, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Calidad.reclamoswwColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Calidad.reclamoswwGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Calidad.reclamoswwGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Calidad.reclamoswwGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOFECHA"
				&TFReclamoFecha.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoFecha_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCODIGO"
				&TFReclamoCodigo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCODIGO_SEL"
				&TFReclamoCodigo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCLIENTE"
				&TFReclamoCliente.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCLIENTE_SEL"
				&TFReclamoCliente_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPLANTACLIENTENOMBRE"
				&TFPlantaClienteNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPLANTACLIENTENOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMODESCRIPCION"
				&TFReclamoDescripcion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMODESCRIPCION_SEL"
				&TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCARRETESREPORTADOS"
				&TFReclamoCarretesReportados.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOMILLARESREPORTADOS"
				&TFReclamoMillaresReportados.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOFECHACIERRE"
				&TFReclamoFechaCierre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMONOTACREDITO"
				&TFReclamoNotaCredito.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoNotaCredito_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOFECHANOTACREDITO"
				&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforeWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(out:&Filename, out:&ErrorMessage);

=== Procedure: Calidad.reclamoswwExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'reclamosww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Reclamo List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoFecha.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoFecha_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFReclamoFecha
		&TFReclamoFecha_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Fecha", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFReclamoFecha_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFReclamoCodigo_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFReclamoCodigo_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFReclamoCodigo.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFReclamoCodigo
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFReclamoCliente_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFReclamoCliente_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFReclamoCliente.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFReclamoCliente
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFPlantaClienteNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFPlantaClienteNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFReclamoDescripcion_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFReclamoDescripcion.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFReclamoDescripcion
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoCarretesReportados.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFReclamoCarretesReportados
		&TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Carretes Reportados", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFReclamoCarretesReportados_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoMillaresReportados.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFReclamoMillaresReportados
		&TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Millares Reportados", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFReclamoMillaresReportados_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoFechaCierre.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFReclamoFechaCierre
		&TFReclamoFechaCierre_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Fecha Cierre", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFReclamoFechaCierre_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoNotaCredito.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFReclamoNotaCredito
		&TFReclamoNotaCredito_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Nota de Crédito", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFReclamoNotaCredito_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito.IsEmpty() AND &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFReclamoFechaNotaCredito
		&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Fecha Nota Crédito", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Reclamo
		order ReclamoFecha  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoFecha)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoCodigo  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoCodigo)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoCliente  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoCliente)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order PlantaClienteNombre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PlantaClienteNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoDescripcion  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoDescripcion)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoCarretesReportados  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoCarretesReportados)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoMillaresReportados  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoMillaresReportados)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoFechaCierre  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoFechaCierre)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoNotaCredito  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoNotaCredito)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ReclamoFechaNotaCredito  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ReclamoFechaNotaCredito)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using reclamoswwDS(&FilterFullText, &TFReclamoFecha, &TFReclamoFecha_To, &TFReclamoCodigo, &TFReclamoCodigo_Sel, &TFReclamoCliente
					, &TFReclamoCliente_Sel, &TFPlantaClienteNombre, &TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel, &TFReclamoDescripcion, &TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados
					, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To, &TFReclamoFechaCierre, &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To, &TFReclamoNotaCredito
					, &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Calidad.reclamoswwGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Calidad.reclamoswwGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Calidad.reclamoswwGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOFECHA"
				&TFReclamoFecha.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoFecha_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCODIGO"
				&TFReclamoCodigo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCODIGO_SEL"
				&TFReclamoCodigo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCLIENTE"
				&TFReclamoCliente.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCLIENTE_SEL"
				&TFReclamoCliente_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPLANTACLIENTENOMBRE"
				&TFPlantaClienteNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPLANTACLIENTENOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMODESCRIPCION"
				&TFReclamoDescripcion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMODESCRIPCION_SEL"
				&TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOCARRETESREPORTADOS"
				&TFReclamoCarretesReportados.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOMILLARESREPORTADOS"
				&TFReclamoMillaresReportados.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOFECHACIERRE"
				&TFReclamoFechaCierre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoFechaCierre_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMONOTACREDITO"
				&TFReclamoNotaCredito.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoNotaCredito_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFRECLAMOFECHANOTACREDITO"
				&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_RECLAMOCODIGO'
		Do 'LoadReclamoCodigoOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_RECLAMOCLIENTE'
		Do 'LoadReclamoClienteOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PLANTACLIENTENOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadPlantaClienteNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_RECLAMODESCRIPCION'
		Do 'LoadReclamoDescripcionOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Calidad.reclamoswwGridState") = !""

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues

Sub 'LoadReclamoCodigoOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFReclamoCodigo = &SearchTxt
	&TFReclamoCodigo_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Reclamo
		Order ReclamoCodigo
		using reclamoswwDS(&FilterFullText, &TFReclamoFecha, &TFReclamoFecha_To, &TFReclamoCodigo, &TFReclamoCodigo_Sel, &TFReclamoCliente
					, &TFReclamoCliente_Sel, &TFPlantaClienteNombre, &TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel, &TFReclamoDescripcion, &TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados
					, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To, &TFReclamoFechaCierre, &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To, &TFReclamoNotaCredito
					, &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each Reclamo
			Order ReclamoCodigo
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ReclamoCodigo.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ReclamoCodigo
			&OptionDesc = trim(ReclamoCodigo.ToFormattedString())
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionsDesc.Add(&OptionDesc)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadReclamoClienteOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFReclamoCliente = &SearchTxt
	&TFReclamoCliente_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Reclamo
		Order ReclamoCliente
		using Calidad.reclamoswwDS(&FilterFullText, &TFReclamoFecha, &TFReclamoFecha_To, &TFReclamoCodigo, &TFReclamoCodigo_Sel, &TFReclamoCliente
					, &TFReclamoCliente_Sel, &TFPlantaClienteNombre, &TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel, &TFReclamoDescripcion, &TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados
					, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To, &TFReclamoFechaCierre, &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To, &TFReclamoNotaCredito
					, &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each Reclamo
			Order ReclamoCliente
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ReclamoCliente.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ReclamoCliente
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadPlantaClienteNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFPlantaClienteNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Reclamo
		Order PlantaClienteId
		using reclamoswwDS(&FilterFullText, &TFReclamoFecha, &TFReclamoFecha_To, &TFReclamoCodigo, &TFReclamoCodigo_Sel, &TFReclamoCliente
					, &TFReclamoCliente_Sel, &TFPlantaClienteNombre, &TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel, &TFReclamoDescripcion, &TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados
					, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To, &TFReclamoFechaCierre, &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To, &TFReclamoNotaCredito
					, &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each Reclamo
			Order PlantaClienteId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not PlantaClienteNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = PlantaClienteNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadReclamoDescripcionOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFReclamoDescripcion = &SearchTxt
	&TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each Reclamo
		Order ReclamoDescripcion
		using reclamoswwDS(&FilterFullText, &TFReclamoFecha, &TFReclamoFecha_To, &TFReclamoCodigo, &TFReclamoCodigo_Sel, &TFReclamoCliente
					, &TFReclamoCliente_Sel, &TFPlantaClienteNombre, &TFPlantaClienteNombre_Sel, &TFReclamoDescripcion, &TFReclamoDescripcion_Sel, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados
					, &TFReclamoCarretesReportados_To, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados, &TFReclamoMillaresReportados_To, &TFReclamoFechaCierre, &TFReclamoFechaCierre_To, &TFReclamoNotaCredito
					, &TFReclamoNotaCredito_To, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito, &TFReclamoFechaNotaCredito_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each Calidad.Reclamo
			Order ReclamoDescripcion
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ReclamoDescripcion.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ReclamoDescripcion
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'

		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Reclamo
		Where ReclamoId = &ReclamoId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDescripcion'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Descripción'

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PlantaClienteNombre'

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = PlantaClienteNombre.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DB.ReclamoId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoFecha'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoFecha.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoEstatus'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoEstatus.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDescripcion'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDescripcion.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoCodigo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoCodigo.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoCarretesReportados'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoCarretesReportados.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoMillaresReportados'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoMillaresReportados.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoCliente'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoCliente.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoFechaCierre'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoFechaCierre.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoNotaCredito'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoNotaCredito.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoFechaNotaCredito'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoFechaNotaCredito.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PlantaClienteId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = PlantaClienteId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'PlantaClienteNombre'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = PlantaClienteNombre.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated ReclamoDetalleProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ReclamoDetalleProductoId"
					&Insert_ReclamoDetalleProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ReclamoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ReclamoId"
					&Insert_ReclamoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
    [web]
    {
	ReclamoDetalleId.Visible = False
	}
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ReclamoDetalleId);

Prompt(CarreteDefectoPrompt, CarreteDefectoId, CarreteDefectoNombre);
ReclamoDetalleId = &ReclamoDetalleId if not &ReclamoDetalleId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ReclamoDetalleId);
noprompt(ReclamoDetalleId);

ReclamoDetalleProductoId = &Insert_ReclamoDetalleProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ReclamoDetalleProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ReclamoDetalleProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ReclamoDetalleProductoId.IsEmpty();
ReclamoId = &Insert_ReclamoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ReclamoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ReclamoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ReclamoId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditReclamoDetalle.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ReclamoDetalleId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
Calidad.LoadAuditReclamoDetalle.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ReclamoDetalleId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditReclamoDetalle.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ReclamoDetalleId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditReclamoDetalle.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ReclamoDetalleId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== DataProvider: Calidad.ReclamoProductoDP ===

--- Source (Source) ---
SDTProducto
{
	SDTProductoItem
	where ProductoTerminadoId > 0
	where TerminadoProductoId > 0
	where ProductoTerminadoConEtiqueta = false
	{
		ProductoId = TerminadoProductoId
		ProductoNombre = TerminadoProductoNombre
	}
}


=== WebPanel: Calidad.CarreteDefectoPrompt ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	Form.Caption = 'Select Carrete Defecto'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Select = !'<i class="fas fa-check"></i>'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&InOutCarreteDefectoId = CarreteDefectoId
	&InOutCarreteDefectoNombre = CarreteDefectoNombre
	Return
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoCleanFilters' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CleanFilters'
	Grid.FirstPage()
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: Calidad.LoadAuditReclamoDetalle ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ReclamoDetalle
		Where ReclamoDetalleId = &ReclamoDetalleId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalle'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Detalle Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoDetalleId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleCodigo'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Carrete'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoDetalleCodigo.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleEstado'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Detalle Estado'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoDetalleEstado.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleObservacionRCA'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Observacion RCA'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoDetalleObservacionRCA.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleProductoId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoDetalleProductoId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleProductoNombre'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoDetalleProductoNombre.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Reclamo Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleMillar'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Reclamo Detalle Millar'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ReclamoDetalleMillar.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		For Each ReclamoDetalle.DB.CarreteDefecto
			
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefecto'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'CarreteDefectoNombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Nombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = CarreteDefectoNombre.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndFor
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ReclamoDetalle
		Where ReclamoDetalleId = &ReclamoDetalleId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalle'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Detalle Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleCodigo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Carrete'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleCodigo.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleEstado'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Detalle Estado'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleEstado.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleObservacionRCA'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Observacion RCA'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleObservacionRCA.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleProductoId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleProductoId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleProductoNombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto Nombre'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleProductoNombre.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Reclamo Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleMillar'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Reclamo Detalle Millar'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleMillar.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			For Each ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto
				
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefecto'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = TrnMode.Insert
				&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)
				
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'CarreteDefectoId'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = CarreteDefectoId.ToString()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'CarreteDefectoNombre'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Nombre'
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
				&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = CarreteDefectoNombre.ToString()
				&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			EndFor
		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			&CountUpdatedCarreteDefectoId = 0
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
				Do Case
					Case &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalle'
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleCodigo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleCodigo.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleEstado'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleEstado.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleObservacionRCA'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleObservacionRCA.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleProductoId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleProductoId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleProductoNombre'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleProductoNombre.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ReclamoDetalleMillar'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ReclamoDetalleMillar.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
				Case &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefecto'
					
					&CountKeyAttributes = 0
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'CarreteDefectoId'
								&KeyCarreteDefectoId.FromString(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue)											
								&CountKeyAttributes += 1
								If &CountKeyAttributes = 1
									Exit
								EndIf
						EndCase
					EndFor

					For Each ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto
						Where CarreteDefectoId = &KeyCarreteDefectoId

						&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = TrnMode.Update
						&CountUpdatedCarreteDefectoId += 1

						For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
							Do Case
								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'CarreteDefectoId'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = CarreteDefectoId.ToString()

								Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'CarreteDefectoNombre'
									&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = CarreteDefectoNombre.ToString()

							EndCase
						EndFor
					When None
						&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = TrnMode.Delete
					EndFor

				EndCase
			EndFor
			If &CountUpdatedCarreteDefectoId < Count(CarreteDefectoId, ReclamoDetalleId = &ReclamoDetalleId)

				&AuditingObjectNewRecords = New()

				For Each ReclamoDetalle.CarreteDefecto
					Where ReclamoDetalleId = &ReclamoDetalleId
					&KeyCarreteDefectoId = CarreteDefectoId
					&RecordExistsCarreteDefectoId = False

					For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
						If &AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefecto'
							&CountKeyAttributes = 0
							For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
								Do Case
									Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'CarreteDefectoId'
										If &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue.Trim() = &KeyCarreteDefectoId.ToString().Trim()
											&RecordExistsCarreteDefectoId = True
											&CountKeyAttributes += 1
											If &CountKeyAttributes = 1
												Exit
											EndIf
										EndIf
								EndCase
							EndFor
						EndIf
					EndFor

					If Not (&RecordExistsCarreteDefectoId)
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.TableName = !'ReclamoDetalleCarreteDefecto'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Mode = TrnMode.Insert
						&AuditingObjectNewRecords.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'CarreteDefectoId'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Id'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = True
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = CarreteDefectoId.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew = New AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Name = !'CarreteDefectoNombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.Description = 'Nombre'
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsPartOfKey = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew.NewValue = CarreteDefectoNombre.ToString()
						&AuditingObjectRecordItemNew.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItemNew)

					EndIf
				EndFor
				For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObjectNewRecords.Record
					&AuditingObject.Record.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItem)
				EndFor
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
